players.product: Recursion OS, biological foundation models, and Lab-in-the-Loop drug engine

quarterly_data.signal: Recursion's 10-K: in 2025 Recursion achieved its first AI-enabled clinical proof of concept - a positive clinical readout in familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP), where REC-4881 (a MEK1/2 inhibitor identified in a high-content phenotypic screen of APC-deficient human cells and in-licensed from Takeda) translated into clinically meaningful reductions in polyp burden in a disease with no approved therapies. The CEO letter says Recursion enters 2026 with five clinical programs advancing with defined differentiation and clear go/no-go criteria.
